integrity: The optimum, complete labeled census, orbit decomposition, and affine/nonlinear split are replayable from the embedded standard-library verifier. Literature searches are evidence of comparison rather than a proof of global novelty.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for binary length 6, cyclic 3-symbol window width 3, and minimum 3-symbol distance 5.
The 768-element translation-dihedral group is verified as an isometry subgroup but is not claimed to be the full isometry group.
An obscure or unindexed finite extremizer census could remain undetected.
title: Equality-case census for binary length-six three-symbol MDS codes
